issues.description: Tiny extraction and the documented demo require data/stories/manifest.json and story files that are not present, so make demo and the integration test fail on a fresh checkout.
Story loading has no generation or fallback path despite the README claiming stories can be loaded or generated.
The end-to-end test depends on missing repository data and currently fails before validating the pipeline.
Committed generated artifacts mask the fact that extraction cannot reproduce them from the current repo contents.
Config values are not validated, allowing empty emotions, zero topics, invalid layer fractions, or bad steering strengths to fail later with unclear errors.
Extraction assumes every configured emotion has loaded stories and will raise late KeyError/ValueError failures if data coverage is partial.
Context validation does not handle zero matching scenarios and can crash on np.stack or emit meaningless empty means.
The HF backend loads the full model directly then moves it to one device, with no device_map, memory checks, or low-memory loading strategy.
HF activation extraction tokenizes without truncation or max-length handling, so long inputs can exceed model context and crash.
Logit-lens scoring applies lm_head directly to residual vectors without the model's final normalization path, making HF results methodologically suspect.
Preference scoring uses only the first token of ' good' and ' bad', which is tokenizer-dependent and can silently mis-score non-Gemma backends.
A PCA variance threshold of 0 still returns one component, which contradicts the intuitive meaning of removing components until 0 percent variance is explained.
The test instructions omit installing the test extra, so a clean environment following setup exactly may not have pytest installed.
